(Japanese: ポケSPedia PokéSPedia) is a special databook made to celebrate the twentieth anniversary of the Pokémon Adventures manga. 

==Publications==
 
 

==Information revealed==
A timeline of the entire series.
The ages and birthdays of , , , , , and .
The genders, levels, natures, and characteristics for several of the Pokédex holders' Pokémon.
is revealed to have obtained a second nicknamed Ririri.
is revealed to own a .
Eldritch is revealed to have been the same Sailor that worked for Lt. Surge.
Green is confirmed to have been the creator of the Silph Scope.

==Errors==
Several of the Pokédex holders' Pokémon's levels are listed as 00.
The moves of Diantha's Gardevoir are the same as Steven's Metagross.
Several of the Pokédex holders' ages are errors.
Several pieces of information about overseas publications are errors.
